item: Absent border files are an answer, not four console errors per map open (row 158)
summary: The optional operator-built OSM border files were found absent by requesting each one, so every map open on an install without them logged four 404 errors. GET /api/geo/border-files names which of the four fixed names exist (is_file only, no caller path, no network); the map requests only those and falls back to asking directly if the answer is unreadable. The Natural Earth legend note is unchanged.
